title: The Bag on the Train
transcript:
Hello. I think I left a bag on the train this morning. Can I report it to you?
Yes. Let me get a description first. What sort of bag was it?
A canvas backpack. It's dark blue, with a little tear next to the front zip.
Thanks. Which station did you get off at? It helps us work out where staff might have checked the carriage.
I got off at Westfield. The train was going through to the coast, though.
Right. A bag like that came in today. Can you tell me one thing that was inside?
There was a lunch box with my initials on the lid. Is that the one?
Yes, that matches. Bring photo ID when you come to claim it, please.
I can come after work. Where exactly is your desk?
We're beside the taxi exit. Come through the doors by the ticket machines and turn left.

questions.explanation: 来电者把遗失物描述为一个深蓝色帆布双肩包。
来电者说自己在 Westfield 站下车，列车随后继续开往海边。

questions.prompt: Item inside the bag with initials: ____
questions.explanation: 来电者说包里有一个午餐盒，盒盖上写着自己姓名的首字母。

questions.prompt: What must the passenger bring to claim the bag?
options: A copy of the train ticket
questions.explanation: 工作人员确认物品相符后，请来电者领取时带上带照片的身份证件。

questions.prompt: Which station feature is beside the lost property desk?
questions.explanation: 工作人员最后说明失物招领处就在出租车出口旁。
